name: Meridian
description: Meridian - Move payments forward together. Near-black navy fintech hero with a full-bleed parallax background video and a staged, word-by-word headline reveal.

typography.display: geometric sans (Avant Garde / Century Gothic lineage), tight -0.055em cap shift

layout: brand mark + MORE pill chrome, no full nav bar
full-bleed hero video on a scaled 1280x800 stage

parallax video playback tied to scroll/pointer
voice: confident and institutional - one short declarative headline plus a single supporting line, no feature dump
